targeted_change.description: V2 adds a sentence-by-sentence review for connected clauses, comparisons, historical dates, policy conditions, and factual assertions embedded in advice.
targeted_change.measured_observation: The completed v2 artifact accepted 29 predictions, with extraction F1 0.1432 and joint F1 0.0593.
targeted_change.interpretation: V2 has measurable local-model output, but the v1 run stopped at 8 of 40 answers, so these aggregate values are not a fair full-split improvement claim.
regressions_or_limitations: The local Ollama model still missed many development gold spans.
Hosted-provider comparison was unavailable because Gemini quota and OpenAI credits were exhausted.
